import Foundation
// 자동 포함: Foundation

func solution(_ title: String, _ nums: [Int], _ k: Int, _ rows: [[Int]]) -> Double {
    return 0.0
}


// ---- 입출력 코드 ----
final class __cib_Reader {
    var d: [UInt8] = []
    var p = 0
    var n = 0
    init() {
        var buf = [UInt8](repeating: 0, count: 1 << 16)
        while true {
            let k = fread(&buf, 1, buf.count, stdin)
            if k <= 0 { break }
            d.append(contentsOf: buf[0..<k])
        }
        n = d.count
    }
    func fail() -> Never {
        fputs("__cib_input\n", stderr)
        exit(1)
    }
    @inline(__always) func ws(_ c: UInt8) -> Bool { return c == 32 || c == 10 || c == 13 || c == 9 }
    func cnt(_ x: Int) -> Int {
        if x < 0 { fail() }
        return x
    }
    func more() -> Bool {
        while p < n && ws(d[p]) { p += 1 }
        return p < n
    }
    func has() -> Bool {
        var q = p
        while q < n && ws(d[q]) { q += 1 }
        return q < n
    }
    func str(_ s: Int, _ e: Int) -> String { return String(decoding: d[s..<e], as: UTF8.self) }
    func tok() -> String {
        if !more() { fail() }
        let s = p
        while p < n && !ws(d[p]) { p += 1 }
        return str(s, p)
    }
    func ll() -> Int {
        if !more() { fail() }
        var neg = false
        if d[p] == 45 || d[p] == 43 { neg = d[p] == 45; p += 1 }
        if p >= n || ws(d[p]) { fail() }
        var v = 0
        while p < n && !ws(d[p]) {
            let c = Int(d[p]) - 48
            if c < 0 || c > 9 { fail() }
            v = v &* 10 &- c
            p += 1
        }
        return neg ? v : 0 &- v
    }
    func pl(_ s: String) -> Int {
        guard let v = Int(s) else { fail() }
        return v
    }
    func pd(_ s: String) -> Double {
        guard let v = Double(s) else { fail() }
        return v
    }
    func dbl() -> Double { return pd(tok()) }
    func nl() {
        if p > 0 && d[p - 1] != 10 {
            while p < n && d[p] != 10 { p += 1 }
            if p < n { p += 1 }
        }
        while true {
            var q = p
            while q < n && d[q] != 10 && ws(d[q]) { q += 1 }
            if q < n && d[q] == 10 { p = q + 1 } else { break }
        }
    }
    func line() -> String {
        if p >= n { fail() }
        var e = p
        while e < n && d[e] != 10 { e += 1 }
        var s = p
        p = e
        while s < e && ws(d[s]) { s += 1 }
        while e > s && ws(d[e - 1]) { e -= 1 }
        return str(s, e)
    }
    func rest() -> [String] {
        if p >= n { fail() }
        var r: [String] = []
        while p < n && d[p] != 10 {
            while p < n && d[p] != 10 && ws(d[p]) { p += 1 }
            let s = p
            while p < n && !ws(d[p]) { p += 1 }
            if p > s { r.append(str(s, p)) }
        }
        return r
    }
}

func __cib_main() {
    let __cib_in = __cib_Reader()
    var __cib_o: [UInt8] = []
    var __cib_cases = 0
    let __cib_end: [String] = ["0", "0"]
    while __cib_in.has() {
        let __cib_s = __cib_in.p
        var __cib_stop = true
        for __cib_w in __cib_end {
            if !__cib_in.more() || __cib_in.tok() != __cib_w {
                __cib_stop = false
                break
            }
        }
        if __cib_stop { break }
        __cib_in.p = __cib_s
        var __cib_v0: String = ""
        var __cib_v1: [Int] = []
        var __cib_v2: Int = 0
        var __cib_v3: [[Int]] = []
        __cib_in.nl()
        __cib_v0 = __cib_in.line()
        __cib_in.nl()
        __cib_v1 = __cib_in.rest().map { __cib_in.pl($0) }
        __cib_v2 = __cib_in.ll()
        __cib_v3 = []; for _ in 0..<__cib_in.cnt(__cib_v2) { __cib_in.nl(); __cib_v3.append(__cib_in.rest().map { __cib_in.pl($0) }) }
        let __cib_res = solution(__cib_v0, __cib_v1, __cib_v2, __cib_v3)
        if __cib_cases > 0 { __cib_o.append(10) }
        __cib_cases += 1
        __cib_o.append(contentsOf: String(format: "%.2f", __cib_res).utf8)
    }
    if __cib_cases > 0 { __cib_o.append(10) }
    __cib_o.withUnsafeBufferPointer { _ = fwrite($0.baseAddress, 1, $0.count, stdout) }
    fflush(stdout)
}

__cib_main()
